title: Cloudflare introduces signed agents so sites can identify and allow or block user-directed AI agents
summary: Cloudflare introduced signed agents, an extension of its verified bots program, as a new bot class for agents directed by end users rather than by a single company: the agent's infrastructure or remote-browsing platform signs each HTTP request with Web Bot Auth and Cloudflare validates the signature, with ChatGPT agent, Block's Goose, Browserbase and Anchor Browser as the first cohort and Cloudflare's own Browser Rendering also listed in the class. Signed agents and the traffic patterns Cloudflare observes for them appear in the public Radar Bots Directory, and Cloudflare said Enterprise customers will soon be able to allow or block signed agents as a group in their firewall rules.

actors.deployer: OpenAI (ChatGPT agent); Block (Goose); Browserbase; Anchor Browser (first cohort)
